## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Naples, Italy. It starts at 32 Via Roma.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Experience Vesuvius in style and ease! Hop aboard a luxurious minibus and ascend to an altitude of 1,000 meters, then continue on foot and explore the crater with a knowledgeable volcanology guide.
>
> When you reach the summit, delight in the magnificent sight of the crater, its fumaroles, and the unparalleled views of Capri, Ischia, Procida, Naples, and Pompeii. Don't miss out on this unique opportunity!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €42.65. It was rated 3.9 out of 5 from 213 ratings and 126 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
